clap.alt1: Bring both hands together to clap.
clap.alt2: Wave one hand at the TV.

scoop_tapioca.real: Scoop a spoonful of black pearl tapioca pearls from the container holding black pearl tapioca pearls with the right arm using the picked-up spoon.
scoop_tapioca.alt1: Use the spoon to scoop up some black tapioca pearls from the container.
scoop_tapioca.alt2: Pour the tapioca pearls from the spoon back into the container.

pour_dressing.real: Pour the picked-up salad dressing onto the meat slice with the left arm.
pour_dressing.alt1: Pour the salad dressing over the slice of meat.
pour_dressing.alt2: Squeeze the salad dressing bottle over the slice of meat.

twist_cap.real: Tighten the bottle cap of the held water bottle with both arms.
twist_cap.alt1: Screw the cap tightly onto the water bottle.
twist_cap.alt2: Unscrew the cap and take it off the water bottle.

turn_faucet.real: Turn off the faucet with the right arm.
turn_faucet.alt1: Rotate the faucet handle to shut off the water.

stamp_form.real: Stamp the document on the table with the stamp in hand using the right arm.
stamp_form.alt1: Press the stamp down onto the paper to stamp it.
stamp_form.alt2: Stamp the paper twice, in two different places.

scan_juice.real: Aim the barcode scanner at the barcode of the held orange juice with the right arm.
scan_juice.alt1: Scan the barcode on the orange juice bottle with the scanner.
scan_juice.alt2: Scan the yellow bottle on the counter with the barcode scanner.

press_ricecooker.real: Press the left arm on the rice cooker.
press_ricecooker.alt1: Press down on the lid of the rice cooker to close it.
press_ricecooker.alt2: Press the button on the front of the rice cooker.

press_oven.real: Press the oven start button with the right arm.
press_oven.alt1: Push the start button on the oven.
press_oven.alt2: Press the oven start button twice.

base_turn.real: Turn to face the curtains with right.
base_turn.alt1: Rotate the robot's body to face the curtains.
base_turn.alt2: Turn to the left, away from the curtains.

base_forward.real: Move forward to approach the guest.
base_forward.alt1: Drive forward toward the person sitting at the table.
base_forward.alt2: Move backward away from the table.

move_guard.real: Move the held hand guard above the vegetable cutter with the right arm.
move_guard.alt1: Bring the hand guard over the vegetable slicer.
move_guard.alt2: Move the hand guard to the side of the counter, away from the slicer.

carry_bag.real: Carry the garbage bag towards the large trash bin with the right arm.
carry_bag.alt1: Carry the bag over to the trash bin.
carry_bag.alt2: Carry the bag toward the wooden table.

wave.real: Lower the left arm while waving the right arm (three times).

cut_dough.real: Cut the dough into small pieces with a knife using both hands.
cut_dough.alt1: Slice the dough into small pieces with the knife.
cut_dough.alt2: Cut the dough into two halves.

knead_dough.real: Knead the dough with both hands.
knead_dough.alt1: Squeeze and press the dough ball with both hands.
knead_dough.alt2: Roll the dough into a long rope.

stir_coffee.real: Stir the coffee in the cup with the spoon held in the right hand.
stir_coffee.alt1: Stir the drink in the cup with the spoon.
stir_coffee.alt2: Shake the cup gently to mix the coffee.

shake_decanter.real: Shake the held decanter with the right arm.
shake_decanter.alt1: Swirl the wine around in the decanter.
shake_decanter.alt2: Pour the wine from the decanter into the glass.

untie_curtain.real: Cooperatively untie the curtain ties with both hands.
untie_curtain.alt1: Undo the tie holding the curtain together.

tie_tieback.real: Tie the velcro curtain tiebacks with both hands.
tie_tieback.alt1: Wrap the tieback around the curtain and fasten the velcro.
tie_tieback.alt2: Untie the curtain tieback and let the curtain hang.

heldout_toast.real: Lift a piece of plain toast from the basket with the left arm.
heldout_toast.alt1: Pick up a slice of bread from the basket.
heldout_toast.alt2: Put a slice of bread into the toaster.

heldout_supermarket.real: Retrieve the small bottle of milk from the cold storage cabinet.
heldout_supermarket.alt1: Take a small milk bottle out of the fridge shelf.
heldout_supermarket.alt2: Put the milk bottle into the shopping cart.

heldout_water.real: Pick up the bottled water with left arm.
heldout_water.alt1: Take one water bottle out of the carton.
heldout_water.alt2: Place a water bottle upright on the table next to the carton.

heldout_curtains.real: Pull the curtain to the level of the windowsill with the right arm.
heldout_curtains.alt1: Pull the curtain down to the windowsill.
heldout_curtains.alt2: Pull the curtain back up to open it.

heldout_menu.real: Carry the held red menu to the table where the guests are seated.
heldout_menu.alt1: Bring the menu over to the guest at the table.
heldout_menu.alt2: Hand the menu to the guest.
